About us

A. General Questions

1. Is this site secure to use?

Yes. Checkout is hosted securely by Shopify and supports the payment methods shown at checkout. We do not store your full card details on our site.

 

2. How quickly do you respond to email queries?

We answer all email within one business days.

 

3. Where are you based?

Dress Like Mommy is an online store operated by FKG Trading LLC in Naples, Florida, USA. We work with manufacturing and fulfillment partners.

 

4. Why are you so cheap?

We select matching family outfits with affordability in mind. Prices and any available discounts are shown on the product page and at checkout.

Before You Place an Order

A. Sizing

1. Where can I find the sizing table in centimetres?

Use the size chart for the specific product and size you are considering. Check the units and whether the chart gives body measurements or garment measurements. Our sizing guide explains how to measure and compare sizes. If a chart or measurement is unclear, contact us before ordering.

 

2. Will I receive a two sizes larger item?

Size labels and measurements vary by product and manufacturer. Choose each item using its product-specific size chart and the available options, rather than assuming your usual letter size or applying a fixed size conversion. If you are unsure, contact us before ordering.

B. Payments

1. What type of payments do you accept?

We accept the payment methods displayed at checkout, including available card options.

 

2. I want to pay with my credit card, but I get redirected to PayPal page?

Select an available payment method at checkout. If you choose a third-party payment option, follow that provider’s instructions or select another available option before paying.

C. Shipping

1. What is the shipping price?

Standard shipping is included in product prices for countries and regions where a standard method is available. Checkout shows the exact shipping method, delivery estimate, and any express upgrade before payment.

 

2. Do you deliver to my country?

We ship to the countries and regions shown at checkout. If your country is not listed at checkout, contact us before placing an order.

 

3. How long will it take to get my order?

Processing and transit times vary by destination and carrier. Review the shipping policy for the current shipping details before checkout.

 

4. Do I need to pay any customs?

Customs duties, import taxes, or local fees may be charged by your destination country and are the customer's responsibility, unless checkout explicitly says they are included. We cannot mark orders as gifts or lower-value shipments.

After You Place an Order

A. Order Status

1. What does it mean: order status "Unfulfilled"?

Your order has not yet been marked as fulfilled. Orders are typically processed within 1-3 business days after payment confirmation. Tracking information is emailed when available after shipment.

 

2. What does it mean: order status "Fulfilled"?

That means your order is being shipped.

 

3. It's been too long, where is my order?

Please check your order's tracking for more information. If the problem remains please email us: info@dresslikemommy.com

B. Order Tracking

1. How do I track my order?

Tracking information is emailed when available after your order ships. You can also check the tracking information here: Track Your Order

 

2. My tracking code says “pending” or “no information available at the moment”.

Tracking may take 24-48 hours to update after the tracking number is issued. If information remains unavailable or your package is delayed, contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. My tracking code says “expired”

Please contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com and we will quickly solve this issue.

 

4. How do I stay updated about my order tracking?

Use the tracking link for the latest carrier updates. If your package is delayed, missing, or marked as delivered but not received, contact us with your order number and tracking information.

B. I want to change or cancel my order

1. I ordered something, but I want to cancel

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number as the subject.

 

2. I ordered something, but want to change the item color or size.

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new color or size option.

 

3. I ordered something, but want to change the delivery address

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new delivery address.

After You Receive an Order

A. I want to change or return my order

1. My order arrived, but the items were two sizes larger

Size labels can vary. If the size or measurements appear inconsistent with your order, contact info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and details. Review our current refund policy before sending an item back.

 

2. My order arrived, but I received the wrong items

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide us with your order number. If we’re at fault, you can send us back the items and we’ll send you out the correct items at our cost (or issue a refund).

 

3. My order arrived and I want to change the size/color

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Approved exchanges follow the current refund policy, including item-condition requirements and return-shipping responsibility.

 

4. My order arrived, but I want to return it.

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Review the refund policy for eligibility, return shipping, and refund timing before sending anything back.

Chi siamo

A. Domande generali

1. Questo sito è sicuro da usare?

Sicuramente sì. Usiamo PayPal per elaborare i pagamenti. Quindi nemmeno il nostro staff vede i tuoi dati di pagamento. PayPal è il più grande fornitore di pagamenti sicuri al mondo. Il nostro sito è costruito sulla piattaforma sicura Shopify. Tutte le tue informazioni personali sono ben protette.

 

2. Quanto velocemente rispondete alle richieste via email?

Rispondiamo a tutte le email entro un giorno lavorativo.

 

3. Dove avete sede?

Le nostre principali operazioni si svolgono nell'Unione Europea accompagnate dal nostro Centro Assistenza in Lituania e dai produttori e magazzini in Asia orientale.

 

4. Perché siete così economici?

Eliminiamo tutti gli intermediari e consegniamo i prodotti direttamente ai consumatori dai nostri produttori, il che ci permette di offrire prezzi estremamente bassi.

Prima di effettuare un ordine

A. Taglie

1. Dove posso trovare la tabella delle taglie in centimetri?

Usa la tabella delle taglie specifica per il prodotto e la taglia che stai valutando. Controlla le unità e se la tabella riporta misure del corpo o del capo. La nostra guida alle taglie spiega come prendere le misure e confrontare le taglie. Se una tabella o una misura non è chiara, contattaci prima di ordinare.

 

2. Riceverò un articolo di due taglie più grande?

Le etichette delle taglie e le misure variano in base al prodotto e al produttore. Scegli ogni capo usando la sua tabella delle taglie e le opzioni disponibili, senza dare per scontato che la tua solita taglia in lettere sia adatta e senza applicare una conversione fissa delle taglie. Se hai dubbi, contattaci prima di ordinare.

B. Pagamenti

1. Quali tipi di pagamento accettate?

Accettiamo PayPal e carte di credito/debito (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover).

 

2. Voglio pagare con la mia carta di credito, ma vengo reindirizzato alla pagina PayPal?

Usiamo PayPal per elaborare tutti i nostri pagamenti. Nella pagina PayPal a destra puoi scegliere tra due opzioni: "Paga con il mio account PayPal" o "Paga con la mia carta di credito o debito"

C. Spedizione

1. Qual è il costo della spedizione?

Offriamo la consegna assolutamente GRATUITA in tutto il mondo.

 

2. Consegnate nel mio paese?

Sì, consegniamo in tutti i paesi del mondo.

 

3. Quanto tempo ci vorrà per ricevere il mio ordine?

La consegna di solito richiede circa 15-30 giorni. Tuttavia, puoi controllare le stime di consegna esatte qui: Pagina di spedizione

 

4. Devo pagare qualche tassa doganale?

No, non devi pagare alcuna tassa doganale. Contrassegniamo tutti i nostri ordini come regali di basso valore. Inoltre, spediamo ordini più grandi in pacchi separati.

Dopo aver effettuato un ordine

A. Stato dell'ordine

1. Cosa significa: stato dell'ordine "Non evaso"?

Il tuo ordine è in fase di elaborazione e il numero di tracciamento dell'ordine è in attesa. Di solito evadiamo gli ordini e inviamo ai nostri clienti il numero di tracciamento quando il numero di tracciamento dell'ordine viene inviato al Sistema Postale, il che richiede 5-7 giorni dopo che l'ordine è già stato spedito.

 

2. Cosa significa: stato ordine "Evaso"?

Questo significa che il tuo ordine è in spedizione.

 

3. È passato troppo tempo, dov'è il mio ordine?

Per favore controlla il tracciamento del tuo ordine per maggiori informazioni. Se il problema persiste, inviaci una email a: support@dresslikemommy.com

B. Tracciamento ordine

1. Come posso tracciare il mio ordine?

Forniamo il codice di tracciamento dell'ordine 5-7 giorni dopo aver effettuato l'ordine. Puoi tracciare il tuo ordine qui: Traccia il tuo ordine

 

2. Il mio codice di tracciamento dice "in attesa" o "nessuna informazione disponibile al momento".

A volte i primi risultati di tracciamento appaiono 5-10 giorni lavorativi dopo aver ricevuto il numero di tracciamento dell'ordine. Se il problema persiste per più di 10 giorni lavorativi, per favore contattaci: support@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. Il mio codice di tracciamento dice "scaduto"

Per favore contattaci: support@dresslikemommy.com e risolveremo rapidamente questo problema.

 

4. Come posso rimanere aggiornato sul tracciamento del mio ordine?

Usiamo il sistema di tracciamento After Ship per seguire gli ordini dei clienti, quindi ogni volta che le informazioni di tracciamento vengono aggiornate, dovresti ricevere una email.

B. Voglio cambiare o cancellare il mio ordine

1. Ho ordinato qualcosa, ma voglio cancellare

Devi contattarci entro 1 giorno lavorativo dall'ordine per organizzare una modifica. Puoi farlo inviando una email a support@dresslikemommy.com con il tuo numero d'ordine come oggetto.

 

2. Ho ordinato qualcosa, ma voglio cambiare il colore o la taglia dell'articolo.

Devi contattarci entro 1 giorno lavorativo dall'ordine per organizzare una modifica. Puoi farlo inviando una email a support@dresslikemommy.com con la tua nuova opzione di colore o taglia.

 

3. Ho ordinato qualcosa, ma voglio cambiare l'indirizzo di consegna

Devi contattarci entro 1 giorno lavorativo dall'ordine per organizzare una modifica. Puoi farlo inviando una email a support@dresslikemommy.com con il tuo nuovo indirizzo di consegna.

Dopo aver ricevuto un ordine

A. Voglio cambiare o restituire il mio ordine

1. Il mio ordine è arrivato, ma gli articoli erano di due taglie più grandi

Le etichette delle taglie possono variare. Se la taglia o le misure sembrano non corrispondere al tuo ordine, contatta support@dresslikemommy.com indicando il numero d’ordine e i dettagli. Consulta la nostra attuale politica sui rimborsi prima di rispedire un articolo.

 

2. Il mio ordine è arrivato, ma ho ricevuto gli articoli sbagliati

Per favore contattaci a support@dresslikemommy.com e fornisci il tuo numero d'ordine. Se è colpa nostra, puoi restituirci gli articoli e ti invieremo quelli corretti a nostre spese (o ti rimborseremo).

 

3. Il mio ordine è arrivato e voglio cambiare la taglia/colore

Per favore contattaci a support@dresslikemommy.com e fornisci il tuo numero d'ordine. Puoi restituirci l'articolo e ti invieremo un nuovo articolo con la taglia aggiornata. *Le spese di spedizione saranno a tuo carico.

 

4. Il mio ordine è arrivato, ma voglio restituirlo.

Per favore contattaci a support@dresslikemommy.com e fornisci il tuo numero d'ordine. Puoi restituirci l'articolo e ti rimborseremo. *Le spese di spedizione saranno a tuo carico.

Our Story

Where Family Fashion Meets Real Connection

Dress Like Mommy was born from a simple idea: families that match together, bond together.

Dress Like Mommy grew from Francisco's family idea in Naples, Florida: the joy his daughters felt when they matched outfits with their mom. That spark — the giggles, the photos, and the "we're twinning!" moments — became the heart of a business dedicated to bringing families closer through fashion.

What We Do

We curate matching outfits for moms, dads, and kids — from cozy holiday pajamas to everyday casual sets and special occasion looks. Every piece is selected with comfort, style, and affordability in mind, so families everywhere can create those picture-perfect moments without breaking the bank.

Our Customers

We serve families across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, and Australia. Whether it's Christmas morning matching pajamas, a family photo shoot, or a fun day out twinning with your mini-me, our customers come to us for coordinated outfits that make getting dressed together simpler.

Quality & Care

Every item in our collection goes through a careful selection process. We partner with trusted manufacturers to offer the latest family matching styles at fair prices. If something isn't right with your order, our customer service team is here to make it right.

Why Shop With Us?

  • Family-Owned Business — Run by a real dad who gets it
  • Standard shipping included where a standard method is available
  • Family Matching Made Easy — Coordinated outfits for photos, holidays, trips, and everyday moments
  • Easy Returns — Clear return and exchange guidance in our refund policy
  • Secure Checkout — Your payment info is always protected

Connect With Us

We love seeing families match! Tag us on social media with #DressLikeMommy and share your moments.

  • Facebook
  • Instagram

Have questions? Visit our Contact Us page — we typically respond within one business day.

Dress Like Mommy — Making family moments even more special.

La Nostra Storia

Dove la Moda Familiare Incontra la Vera Connessione

Dress Like Mommy è nata da un'idea semplice: le famiglie che si vestono in modo coordinato, si legano di più.

Fondata nel 2016 da Francisco, padre di due bambine a Naples, Florida, Dress Like Mommy è iniziata quando ha notato come le sue figlie si illuminassero ogni volta che si vestivano in modo coordinato con la mamma. Quella scintilla di gioia — le risate, le foto, i momenti di "siamo uguali!" — è diventata il cuore di un’attività dedicata ad avvicinare le famiglie attraverso la moda.

Cosa Facciamo

Selezioniamo outfit coordinati per mamme, papà e bambini — dai comodi pigiami per le feste ai completi casual di tutti i giorni e agli abiti per occasioni speciali. Ogni capo è scelto pensando al comfort, allo stile e alla convenienza, così che le famiglie di tutto il mondo possano creare quei momenti perfetti senza spendere troppo.

I Nostri Clienti

Dal 2016, abbiamo servito migliaia di famiglie negli Stati Uniti, Canada, Regno Unito e Australia. Che si tratti dei pigiami coordinati per la mattina di Natale, di un servizio fotografico di famiglia o semplicemente di una giornata divertente a vestirsi uguali con il tuo mini-me, i nostri clienti tornano sempre per i sorrisi che questi outfit creano.

Qualità e Cura

Ogni articolo della nostra collezione passa attraverso un attento processo di selezione. Collaboriamo con produttori affidabili per offrire gli ultimi stili coordinati per famiglie a prezzi equi. Se qualcosa non va con il tuo ordine, il nostro servizio clienti è qui per risolvere il problema.

Perché Acquistare da Noi?

  • Azienda a Gestione Familiare — Gestita da un vero papà che capisce
  • Spedizione Gratuita su tutti gli ordini
  • Migliaia di Famiglie Soddisfatte dal 2016
  • Resi Facili — Politica di reso senza problemi entro 30 giorni
  • Pagamento Sicuro — Le tue informazioni di pagamento sono sempre protette

Connettiti con Noi

Ci piace vedere le famiglie coordinate! Taggaci sui social media con #DressLikeMommy e condividi i tuoi momenti.

  • Facebook
  • Instagram

Hai domande? Visita la nostra pagina Contattaci — di solito rispondiamo entro un giorno lavorativo.

About us

A. General Questions

1. Is this site secure to use?

Yes. Checkout is hosted securely by Shopify and supports the payment methods shown at checkout. We do not store your full card details on our site.

 

2. How quickly do you respond to email queries?

We answer all email within one business days.

 

3. Where are you based?

Dress Like Mommy is an online store operated by FKG Trading LLC in Naples, Florida, USA. We work with manufacturing and fulfillment partners.

 

4. Why are you so cheap?

We select matching family outfits with affordability in mind. Prices and any available discounts are shown on the product page and at checkout.

Before You Place an Order

A. Sizing

1. Where can I find the sizing table in centimetres?

Use the size chart for the specific product and size you are considering. Check the units and whether the chart gives body measurements or garment measurements. Our sizing guide explains how to measure and compare sizes. If a chart or measurement is unclear, contact us before ordering.

 

2. Will I receive a two sizes larger item?

Size labels and measurements vary by product and manufacturer. Choose each item using its product-specific size chart and the available options, rather than assuming your usual letter size or applying a fixed size conversion. If you are unsure, contact us before ordering.

B. Payments

1. What type of payments do you accept?

We accept the payment methods displayed at checkout, including available card options.

 

2. I want to pay with my credit card, but I get redirected to PayPal page?

Select an available payment method at checkout. If you choose a third-party payment option, follow that provider’s instructions or select another available option before paying.

C. Shipping

1. What is the shipping price?

Standard shipping is included in product prices for countries and regions where a standard method is available. Checkout shows the exact shipping method, delivery estimate, and any express upgrade before payment.

 

2. Do you deliver to my country?

We ship to the countries and regions shown at checkout. If your country is not listed at checkout, contact us before placing an order.

 

3. How long will it take to get my order?

Processing and transit times vary by destination and carrier. Review the shipping policy for the current shipping details before checkout.

 

4. Do I need to pay any customs?

Customs duties, import taxes, or local fees may be charged by your destination country and are the customer's responsibility, unless checkout explicitly says they are included. We cannot mark orders as gifts or lower-value shipments.

After You Place an Order

A. Order Status

1. What does it mean: order status "Unfulfilled"?

Your order has not yet been marked as fulfilled. Orders are typically processed within 1-3 business days after payment confirmation. Tracking information is emailed when available after shipment.

 

2. What does it mean: order status "Fulfilled"?

That means your order is being shipped.

 

3. It's been too long, where is my order?

Please check your order's tracking for more information. If the problem remains please email us: info@dresslikemommy.com

B. Order Tracking

1. How do I track my order?

Tracking information is emailed when available after your order ships. You can also check the tracking information here: Track Your Order

 

2. My tracking code says “pending” or “no information available at the moment”.

Tracking may take 24-48 hours to update after the tracking number is issued. If information remains unavailable or your package is delayed, contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. My tracking code says “expired”

Please contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com and we will quickly solve this issue.

 

4. How do I stay updated about my order tracking?

Use the tracking link for the latest carrier updates. If your package is delayed, missing, or marked as delivered but not received, contact us with your order number and tracking information.

B. I want to change or cancel my order

1. I ordered something, but I want to cancel

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number as the subject.

 

2. I ordered something, but want to change the item color or size.

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new color or size option.

 

3. I ordered something, but want to change the delivery address

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new delivery address.

After You Receive an Order

A. I want to change or return my order

1. My order arrived, but the items were two sizes larger

Size labels can vary. If the size or measurements appear inconsistent with your order, contact info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and details. Review our current refund policy before sending an item back.

 

2. My order arrived, but I received the wrong items

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide us with your order number. If we’re at fault, you can send us back the items and we’ll send you out the correct items at our cost (or issue a refund).

 

3. My order arrived and I want to change the size/color

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Approved exchanges follow the current refund policy, including item-condition requirements and return-shipping responsibility.

 

4. My order arrived, but I want to return it.

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Review the refund policy for eligibility, return shipping, and refund timing before sending anything back.

私たちについて

A. 一般的な質問

1. このサイトは安全に使えますか？

はい、安全です。支払いはPayPalで処理しているため、スタッフもお客様の支払い情報を見ることはありません。PayPalは世界最大の安全な決済プロバイダーです。当サイトはShopifyの安全なプラットフォーム上に構築されており、個人情報は厳重に保護されています。

 

2. メールの問い合わせにはどのくらい早く対応しますか？

すべてのメールには1営業日以内に返信しています。

 

3. どこに拠点がありますか？

主な拠点は欧州連合内にあり、リトアニアのサポートセンターと東アジアの製造工場および倉庫と連携しています。

 

4. なぜこんなに安いのですか？

中間業者を省き、製造元から直接お客様に商品をお届けしているため、非常に低価格で提供できます。

ご注文前に

A. サイズ

1. センチメートル単位のサイズ表はどこで見られますか？

検討中の商品とサイズに対応するサイズ表をご確認ください。単位と、表が体の寸法を示しているのか、衣服の寸法を示しているのかも確認してください。サイズガイドでは、採寸方法とサイズの比較方法をご案内しています。表や寸法がわかりにくい場合は、ご注文前にお問い合わせください。

 

2. 2サイズ大きい商品が届きますか？

サイズ表記や寸法は、商品やメーカーによって異なります。普段着用しているアルファベットのサイズが合うと決めつけたり、固定のサイズ換算を当てはめたりせず、各商品のサイズ表と選択可能なオプションを確認してお選びください。ご不明な点がある場合は、ご注文前にお問い合わせください。

B. 支払い

1. どのような支払い方法が使えますか？

PayPalとクレジット/デビットカード（Visa、Mastercard、American Express、Discover）を受け付けています。

 

2. クレジットカードで支払いたいのにPayPalのページにリダイレクトされますか？

すべての支払いはPayPalで処理しています。PayPalのページ右側で「PayPalアカウントで支払う」または「クレジットカードまたはデビットカードで支払う」の2つのオプションから選べます。

C. 配送

1. 配送料はいくらですか？

世界中どこでも完全無料で配送しています。

 

2. 私の国にも配送していますか？

はい、配送しています。世界中すべての国にお届けします。

 

3. 注文が届くまでどのくらいかかりますか？

配送には通常15〜30日かかります。ただし、正確な配送予定はここでご確認いただけます：配送ページ

 

4. 関税は支払う必要がありますか？

いいえ、関税はお支払いいただく必要はありません。すべての注文を低価格のギフトとして申告しています。さらに、大きな注文は別々のパッケージで発送しています。

ご注文後

A. 注文状況

1. 注文状況「未発送」とはどういう意味ですか？

ご注文は処理中で、注文の追跡番号はまだ保留中です。通常、ご注文が発送された後5〜7日で郵便システムに追跡番号が登録され、その時点でお客様に追跡番号をお知らせしています。

 

2. 注文状況「Fulfilled」とはどういう意味ですか？

これはご注文が発送中であることを意味します。

 

3. かなり時間が経ちましたが、注文はどこにありますか？

詳細はご注文の追跡情報をご確認ください。問題が続く場合はメールでご連絡ください： support@dresslikemommy.com

B. 注文追跡

1. 注文をどうやって追跡しますか？

ご注文後5～7日で追跡コードをお知らせします。こちらでご注文を追跡できます：注文を追跡する

 

2. 追跡コードが「保留中」または「現在情報がありません」と表示されます。

追跡番号を受け取ってから5～10営業日後に最初の追跡結果が表示されることがあります。10営業日以上問題が続く場合はお問い合わせください： support@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. 追跡コードが「期限切れ」と表示されます。

お問い合わせはこちらまで： support@dresslikemommy.com 迅速に問題を解決いたします。

当店ではAfter Ship追跡システムを使用しており、追跡情報が更新されるとメールが届きます。

1. 注文しましたが、キャンセルしたいです。

注文変更の手配は、ご注文後1営業日以内にご連絡ください。メールでご連絡いただけます。 support@dresslikemommy.com 件名にご注文番号を記載してください。

Our Story

Where Family Fashion Meets Real Connection

Dress Like Mommy was born from a simple idea: families that match together, bond together.

Dress Like Mommy grew from Francisco's family idea in Naples, Florida: the joy his daughters felt when they matched outfits with their mom. That spark — the giggles, the photos, and the "we're twinning!" moments — became the heart of a business dedicated to bringing families closer through fashion.

What We Do

We curate matching outfits for moms, dads, and kids — from cozy holiday pajamas to everyday casual sets and special occasion looks. Every piece is selected with comfort, style, and affordability in mind, so families everywhere can create those picture-perfect moments without breaking the bank.

Our Customers

We serve families across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, and Australia. Whether it's Christmas morning matching pajamas, a family photo shoot, or a fun day out twinning with your mini-me, our customers come to us for coordinated outfits that make getting dressed together simpler.

Quality & Care

Every item in our collection goes through a careful selection process. We partner with trusted manufacturers to offer the latest family matching styles at fair prices. If something isn't right with your order, our customer service team is here to make it right.

Why Shop With Us?

  • Family-Owned Business — Run by a real dad who gets it
  • Standard shipping included where a standard method is available
  • Family Matching Made Easy — Coordinated outfits for photos, holidays, trips, and everyday moments
  • Easy Returns — Clear return and exchange guidance in our refund policy
  • Secure Checkout — Your payment info is always protected

Connect With Us

We love seeing families match! Tag us on social media with #DressLikeMommy and share your moments.

  • Facebook
  • Instagram

Have questions? Visit our Contact Us page — we typically respond within one business day.

Dress Like Mommy — Making family moments even more special.

About us

A. General Questions

1. Is this site secure to use?

Yes. Checkout is hosted securely by Shopify and supports the payment methods shown at checkout. We do not store your full card details on our site.

 

2. How quickly do you respond to email queries?

We answer all email within one business days.

 

3. Where are you based?

Dress Like Mommy is an online store operated by FKG Trading LLC in Naples, Florida, USA. We work with manufacturing and fulfillment partners.

 

4. Why are you so cheap?

We select matching family outfits with affordability in mind. Prices and any available discounts are shown on the product page and at checkout.

Before You Place an Order

A. Sizing

1. Where can I find the sizing table in centimetres?

모든 이메일에 영업일 기준 하루 이내에 답변합니다.

 

3. 어디에 기반을 두고 있나요?

주요 운영은 유럽 연합에서 이루어지며, 리투아니아에 지원 센터가 있고 동아시아에 제조사와 창고가 있습니다.

 

4. 왜 이렇게 저렴한가요?

중간 유통 과정을 없애고 제조사에서 직접 소비자에게 제품을 배송하여 매우 저렴한 가격을 제공합니다.

주문 전

A. 사이즈

1. 센티미터 단위 사이즈 표는 어디서 찾을 수 있나요?

구매를 고려 중인 해당 상품과 사이즈의 사이즈표를 확인하세요. 측정 단위와 표에 표시된 치수가 신체 치수인지 의류 치수인지도 확인하세요. 사이즈 가이드에서 치수를 재고 사이즈를 비교하는 방법을 안내합니다. 표나 치수가 명확하지 않으면 주문 전에 문의해 주세요.

 

2. 두 사이즈 큰 제품을 받게 되나요?

사이즈 표기와 치수는 상품과 제조사에 따라 다릅니다. 평소 입는 알파벳 사이즈가 맞을 것이라고 가정하거나 고정된 사이즈 변환 규칙을 적용하지 말고, 각 상품의 사이즈표와 선택 가능한 옵션을 확인하여 골라 주세요. 확실하지 않으면 주문 전에 문의해 주세요.

PayPal과 신용/직불카드(Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover)를 받습니다.

 

2. 신용카드로 결제하려는데 PayPal 페이지로 리디렉션되나요?

저희는 모든 결제를 PayPal로 처리합니다. 오른쪽 PayPal 페이지에서 두 가지 옵션 중 선택할 수 있습니다: "내 PayPal 계정으로 결제" 또는 "신용카드 또는 직불카드로 결제"

전 세계 어디든 완전 무료 배송을 제공합니다.

 

2. 제 나라로 배송하나요?

네, 전 세계 모든 국가로 배송합니다.

배송은 보통 15-30일 정도 걸립니다. 하지만 정확한 배송 예상일은 여기에서 확인하실 수 있습니다: 배송 페이지

주문이 배송 중임을 의미합니다.

더 자세한 정보는 주문 추적을 확인해 주세요. 문제가 계속되면 이메일로 문의해 주세요: support@dresslikemommy.com

주문 후 5-7일 후에 추적 코드를 제공합니다. 여기에서 주문을 추적할 수 있습니다: 주문 추적

가끔 주문 추적 번호를 받은 후 5-10 영업일 후에 첫 추적 결과가 나타납니다. 10영업일 이상 문제가 지속되면 연락해 주세요: support@dresslikemommy.com

문의는 다음으로 연락해 주세요: support@dresslikemommy.com 문제를 신속히 해결해 드리겠습니다.

저희는 After Ship 추적 시스템을 사용하여 고객 주문을 추적하므로, 추적 정보가 업데이트되면 이메일을 받으실 수 있습니다.

주문을 받으신 후

일반 배송을 이용할 수 있는 국가와 지역에서는 상품 가격에 일반 배송비가 포함됩니다. 결제 전 결제 단계에서 정확한 배송 방법, 예상 배송일 및 이용 가능한 특급 배송 업그레이드를 확인할 수 있습니다.

 

2. 제 나라로 배송하나요?

결제 화면에 표시되는 국가와 지역으로 배송합니다. 결제 화면에 고객님의 국가가 표시되지 않으면 주문 전에 문의해 주세요.

 

3. 내 주문은 얼마나 걸리나요?

주문 처리 및 운송 기간은 배송지와 배송업체에 따라 다릅니다. 결제 전에 배송 정책에서 최신 배송 정보를 확인하세요.

 

4. 관세를 내야 하나요?

배송지 국가에서 관세, 수입세 또는 현지 수수료를 부과할 수 있으며, 결제 화면에 포함되어 있다고 명시된 경우를 제외하고 해당 비용은 고객 부담입니다. 주문을 선물로 표시하거나 실제보다 낮은 금액의 배송품으로 신고할 수 없습니다.

주문 후

A. 주문 상태

1. 주문 상태 "미처리"는 무슨 뜻인가요?

아직 주문 처리 완료로 표시되지 않은 상태입니다. 주문은 일반적으로 결제 확인 후 1-3영업일 이내에 처리됩니다. 배송 조회 정보는 발송 후 확인이 가능해지면 이메일로 안내합니다.

 

2. 주문 상태 "완료"는 무슨 뜻인가요?

주문이 배송 중임을 의미합니다.

 

3. 너무 오래 걸렸는데 내 주문은 어디 있나요?

더 자세한 정보는 주문 추적을 확인해 주세요. 문제가 계속되면 이메일로 문의해 주세요: info@dresslikemommy.com

운송장 번호가 발급된 후 배송 조회 정보가 업데이트되기까지 24-48시간이 걸릴 수 있습니다. 계속 정보가 표시되지 않거나 배송이 지연되는 경우 문의해 주세요: info@dresslikemommy.com

문의는 다음으로 연락해 주세요: info@dresslikemommy.com 문제를 신속히 해결해 드리겠습니다.

1. 주문했는데 취소하고 싶어요.

주문 변경을 원하시면 주문 후 1영업일 이내에 연락해 주세요. 이메일로 연락하실 수 있습니다. info@dresslikemommy.com 주문 번호를 제목으로 하여.

 

2. 주문했는데 상품 색상이나 사이즈를 변경하고 싶어요.

주문 변경을 원하시면 주문 후 1영업일 이내에 연락해 주세요. 이메일로 연락하실 수 있습니다. info@dresslikemommy.com 새로운 색상 또는 사이즈 옵션과 함께.

주문 변경을 원하시면 주문 후 1영업일 이내에 연락해 주세요. 이메일로 연락하실 수 있습니다. info@dresslikemommy.com 새 배송 주소와 함께.

info@dresslikemommy.com으로 연락하여 주문 번호를 알려 주세요. 승인된 교환에는 상품 상태 요건과 반품 배송비 부담을 포함한 현재 환불 정책이 적용됩니다.

Our Story

Where Family Fashion Meets Real Connection

Dress Like Mommy was born from a simple idea: families that match together, bond together.

Dress Like Mommy grew from Francisco's family idea in Naples, Florida: the joy his daughters felt when they matched outfits with their mom. That spark — the giggles, the photos, and the "we're twinning!" moments — became the heart of a business dedicated to bringing families closer through fashion.

What We Do

We curate matching outfits for moms, dads, and kids — from cozy holiday pajamas to everyday casual sets and special occasion looks. Every piece is selected with comfort, style, and affordability in mind, so families everywhere can create those picture-perfect moments without breaking the bank.

Our Customers

We serve families across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, and Australia. Whether it's Christmas morning matching pajamas, a family photo shoot, or a fun day out twinning with your mini-me, our customers come to us for coordinated outfits that make getting dressed together simpler.

Quality & Care

Every item in our collection goes through a careful selection process. We partner with trusted manufacturers to offer the latest family matching styles at fair prices. If something isn't right with your order, our customer service team is here to make it right.

Why Shop With Us?

  • Family-Owned Business — Run by a real dad who gets it
  • Standard shipping included where a standard method is available
  • Family Matching Made Easy — Coordinated outfits for photos, holidays, trips, and everyday moments
  • Easy Returns — Clear return and exchange guidance in our refund policy
  • Secure Checkout — Your payment info is always protected

Connect With Us

We love seeing families match! Tag us on social media with #DressLikeMommy and share your moments.

  • Facebook
  • Instagram

Have questions? Visit our Contact Us page — we typically respond within one business day.

우리 이야기

가족 패션과 진정한 연결이 만나는 곳

Dress Like Mommy는 간단한 아이디어에서 시작되었습니다: 함께 맞춰 입는 가족은 더 가까워진다.

2016년 플로리다 네이플스에서 두 딸의 아버지 프란시스코가 설립한 Dress Like Mommy는 딸들이 엄마와 옷을 맞춰 입을 때마다 반짝이는 기쁨을 발견하면서 시작되었습니다. 그 기쁨의 불꽃 — 웃음소리, 사진, "우린 쌍둥이야!" 순간들 — 은 가족을 패션으로 더 가깝게 만드는 사업의 중심이 되었습니다.

우리가 하는 일

엄마, 아빠, 아이들을 위한 맞춤 옷을 엄선합니다 — 포근한 휴일 파자마부터 일상 캐주얼 세트, 특별한 날의 스타일까지. 모든 제품은 편안함, 스타일, 합리적인 가격을 고려해 선택되어, 어디서나 가족들이 부담 없이 완벽한 순간을 만들 수 있도록 합니다.

우리 고객

2016년부터 미국, 캐나다, 영국, 호주 전역의 수천 가족에게 서비스를 제공해왔습니다. 크리스마스 아침 맞춤 파자마, 가족 사진 촬영, 또는 미니미와 함께하는 즐거운 외출 등, 우리 고객들은 이 옷들이 만들어내는 미소를 위해 계속 찾아옵니다.

품질과 케어

우리 컬렉션의 모든 아이템은 신중한 선정 과정을 거칩니다. 신뢰할 수 있는 제조업체와 협력하여 최신 가족 맞춤 스타일을 합리적인 가격에 제공합니다. 주문에 문제가 있을 경우, 고객 서비스 팀이 문제를 해결해 드립니다.

왜 우리와 함께 쇼핑해야 할까요?

  • 가족 소유 사업 — 진짜 아버지가 운영합니다
  • 모든 주문 무료 배송
  • 2016년부터 수천 명의 행복한 가족
  • 간편한 반품 — 30일 무조건 반품 정책
  • 안전한 결제 — 결제 정보는 항상 보호됩니다

우리와 소통하세요

가족이 맞춰 입는 모습을 보는 것을 좋아합니다! 소셜 미디어에서 #DressLikeMommy 태그를 달아 여러분의 순간을 공유해 주세요.

엄마, 아빠, 아이들이 함께 맞춰 입을 수 있는 옷을 엄선합니다. 포근한 휴일 파자마부터 일상적인 캐주얼 세트와 특별한 날의 스타일까지 준비되어 있습니다. 모든 제품은 편안함, 스타일, 합리적인 가격을 고려해 선택하므로 가족들이 큰 부담 없이 사진으로 남길 만한 순간을 만들 수 있습니다.

우리 고객

미국, 캐나다, 영국, 호주 전역의 가족에게 서비스를 제공합니다. 크리스마스 아침에 함께 맞춰 입는 파자마, 가족 사진 촬영, 아이와 함께 옷을 맞춰 입고 즐기는 외출 등, 고객들은 온 가족이 함께 옷을 고르고 입기 쉽게 해 주는 패밀리룩을 찾습니다.

품질과 케어

컬렉션의 모든 상품은 신중한 선정 과정을 거칩니다. 신뢰할 수 있는 제조업체와 협력하여 가족이 함께 맞춰 입는 최신 스타일을 합리적인 가격에 제공합니다. 주문에 문제가 있으면 고객 서비스 팀이 해결을 도와드립니다.

왜 우리와 함께 쇼핑해야 할까요?

  • 가족 소유 사업 — 진짜 아버지가 운영합니다
  • 일반 배송비 포함 — 일반 배송을 이용할 수 있는 지역에 해당합니다
  • 가족이 함께 맞춰 입기 쉽게 — 사진 촬영, 휴일, 여행과 일상의 순간을 위한 패밀리룩
  • 간편한 반품 — 환불 정책에서 반품 및 교환에 관한 명확한 안내를 확인하세요
  • 안전한 결제 — 결제 정보는 항상 보호됩니다

우리와 소통하세요

가족이 맞춰 입는 모습을 보는 것을 좋아합니다! 소셜 미디어에서 #DressLikeMommy 태그를 달아 여러분의 순간을 공유해 주세요.

  • 페이스북
  • 인스타그램

궁금한 점이 있으신가요? 문의하기 페이지를 방문해 주세요 — 보통 영업일 기준 하루 이내에 답변 드립니다.

Dress Like Mommy — 가족의 순간을 더욱 특별하게 만듭니다.

About us

A. General Questions

1. Is this site secure to use?

Yes. Checkout is hosted securely by Shopify and supports the payment methods shown at checkout. We do not store your full card details on our site.

 

2. How quickly do you respond to email queries?

We answer all email within one business days.

 

3. Where are you based?

Dress Like Mommy is an online store operated by FKG Trading LLC in Naples, Florida, USA. We work with manufacturing and fulfillment partners.

 

4. Why are you so cheap?

We select matching family outfits with affordability in mind. Prices and any available discounts are shown on the product page and at checkout.

Before You Place an Order

A. Sizing

1. Where can I find the sizing table in centimetres?

Use the size chart for the specific product and size you are considering. Check the units and whether the chart gives body measurements or garment measurements. Our sizing guide explains how to measure and compare sizes. If a chart or measurement is unclear, contact us before ordering.

 

2. Will I receive a two sizes larger item?

Size labels and measurements vary by product and manufacturer. Choose each item using its product-specific size chart and the available options, rather than assuming your usual letter size or applying a fixed size conversion. If you are unsure, contact us before ordering.

B. Payments

1. What type of payments do you accept?

We accept the payment methods displayed at checkout, including available card options.

 

2. I want to pay with my credit card, but I get redirected to PayPal page?

Select an available payment method at checkout. If you choose a third-party payment option, follow that provider’s instructions or select another available option before paying.

C. Shipping

1. What is the shipping price?

Standard shipping is included in product prices for countries and regions where a standard method is available. Checkout shows the exact shipping method, delivery estimate, and any express upgrade before payment.

 

2. Do you deliver to my country?

We ship to the countries and regions shown at checkout. If your country is not listed at checkout, contact us before placing an order.

 

3. How long will it take to get my order?

Processing and transit times vary by destination and carrier. Review the shipping policy for the current shipping details before checkout.

 

4. Do I need to pay any customs?

Customs duties, import taxes, or local fees may be charged by your destination country and are the customer's responsibility, unless checkout explicitly says they are included. We cannot mark orders as gifts or lower-value shipments.

After You Place an Order

A. Order Status

1. What does it mean: order status "Unfulfilled"?

Your order has not yet been marked as fulfilled. Orders are typically processed within 1-3 business days after payment confirmation. Tracking information is emailed when available after shipment.

 

2. What does it mean: order status "Fulfilled"?

That means your order is being shipped.

 

3. It's been too long, where is my order?

Please check your order's tracking for more information. If the problem remains please email us: info@dresslikemommy.com

B. Order Tracking

1. How do I track my order?

Tracking information is emailed when available after your order ships. You can also check the tracking information here: Track Your Order

 

2. My tracking code says “pending” or “no information available at the moment”.

Tracking may take 24-48 hours to update after the tracking number is issued. If information remains unavailable or your package is delayed, contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. My tracking code says “expired”

Please contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com and we will quickly solve this issue.

 

4. How do I stay updated about my order tracking?

Use the tracking link for the latest carrier updates. If your package is delayed, missing, or marked as delivered but not received, contact us with your order number and tracking information.

B. I want to change or cancel my order

1. I ordered something, but I want to cancel

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number as the subject.

 

2. I ordered something, but want to change the item color or size.

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new color or size option.

 

3. I ordered something, but want to change the delivery address

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new delivery address.

After You Receive an Order

A. I want to change or return my order

1. My order arrived, but the items were two sizes larger

Size labels can vary. If the size or measurements appear inconsistent with your order, contact info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and details. Review our current refund policy before sending an item back.

 

2. My order arrived, but I received the wrong items

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide us with your order number. If we’re at fault, you can send us back the items and we’ll send you out the correct items at our cost (or issue a refund).

 

3. My order arrived and I want to change the size/color

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Approved exchanges follow the current refund policy, including item-condition requirements and return-shipping responsibility.

 

4. My order arrived, but I want to return it.

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Review the refund policy for eligibility, return shipping, and refund timing before sending anything back.

Om oss

A. Generelle spørsmål

1. Er dette nettstedet sikkert å bruke?

Det er det absolutt. Vi bruker PayPal for å behandle betalinger. Så ikke engang vårt personale får se betalingsdetaljene dine. PayPal er verdens største sikre betalingsleverandør. Nettstedet vårt er bygget på Shopify sin sikre plattform. All din personlige informasjon er godt beskyttet.

 

2. Hvor raskt svarer dere på e-posthenvendelser?

Vi svarer på alle e-poster innen én virkedag.

 

3. Hvor holder dere til?

Vår hovedvirksomhet drives i EU, støttet av vårt kundesenter i Litauen og produsenter og lagre i Øst-Asia.

 

4. Hvorfor er dere så billige?

Vi kutter ut alle mellomledd og leverer produktene direkte til forbrukerne fra våre produsenter, noe som gjør at vi kan tilby ekstremt lave priser.

Før du legger inn en bestilling

A. Størrelser

1. Hvor kan jeg finne størrelsestabellen i centimeter?

Bruk størrelsestabellen for det bestemte produktet og den størrelsen du vurderer. Kontroller måleenhetene og om tabellen viser kroppsmål eller plaggets mål. Vår størrelsesguide forklarer hvordan du måler og sammenligner størrelser. Kontakt oss før du bestiller hvis en tabell eller et mål er uklart.

 

2. Vil jeg motta et plagg som er to størrelser større?

Størrelsesbetegnelser og mål varierer med produkt og produsent. Velg hvert plagg ut fra produktets egen størrelsestabell og de tilgjengelige alternativene, i stedet for å anta at din vanlige bokstavstørrelse passer eller bruke en fast størrelsesomregning. Kontakt oss før du bestiller hvis du er usikker.

B. Betalinger

1. Hvilke betalingsmetoder godtar dere?

Vi godtar PayPal og kreditt-/debetkort (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover).

 

2. Jeg vil betale med kredittkort, men blir omdirigert til PayPal-siden?

Vi bruker PayPal for å behandle alle betalingene våre. På PayPal-siden til høyre kan du velge mellom to alternativer: "Betal med min PayPal-konto" eller "Betal med mitt kreditt- eller debetkort"

C. Frakt

1. Hva er fraktprisen?

Vi tilbyr helt GRATIS levering over hele verden.

 

2. Leverer dere til mitt land?

Ja, det gjør vi. Vi leverer til alle land i hele verden.

 

3. Hvor lang tid tar det å få bestillingen min?

Leveringen tar vanligvis omtrent 15-30 dager. Du kan imidlertid sjekke nøyaktige leveringsestimater her: Frakt-side

 

4. Må jeg betale toll?

Nei, du trenger ikke å betale tollavgift. Vi merker alle bestillingene våre som gaver med lav verdi. Dessuten sender vi større bestillinger i separate pakker.

Etter at du har lagt inn en bestilling

A. Bestillingsstatus

1. Hva betyr det: bestillingsstatus "Uoppfylt"?

Bestillingen din behandles, og sporingsnummeret for bestillingen er under behandling. Vi pleier å fullføre bestillingene og sende kundene våre sporingsnummeret når bestillingens sporingsnummer er sendt til postsystemet, noe som tar 5-7 dager etter at bestillingen allerede er sendt.

 

2. Hva betyr det: bestillingsstatus "Fulfilled"?

Det betyr at bestillingen din er under sending.

 

3. Det har gått for lang tid, hvor er bestillingen min?

Vennligst sjekk sporingen for mer informasjon. Hvis problemet vedvarer, vennligst send oss en e-post: support@dresslikemommy.com

B. Bestillingssporing

1. Hvordan sporer jeg bestillingen min?

Vi gir deg sporingskoden 5-7 dager etter at du har lagt inn bestillingen. Du kan spore bestillingen her: Spor bestillingen din

 

2. Sporingskoden min sier «venter» eller «ingen informasjon tilgjengelig for øyeblikket».

Noen ganger vises de første sporingsresultatene 5-10 virkedager etter at du mottar sporingsnummeret. Hvis problemet vedvarer i mer enn 10 virkedager, vennligst kontakt oss: support@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. Sporingskoden min sier «utløpt»

Vennligst kontakt oss: support@dresslikemommy.com og vi vil raskt løse dette problemet.

 

4. Hvordan holder jeg meg oppdatert om bestillingssporing?

Vi bruker After Ship sporing for å følge opp kundebestillinger, så når sporingsinformasjonen oppdateres, vil du motta en e-post.

B. Jeg vil endre eller avbestille bestillingen min

1. Jeg bestilte noe, men vil avbestille

Du må kontakte oss innen 1 virkedag etter at bestillingen er lagt inn for å ordne en endring. Du kan gjøre dette ved å sende e-post til support@dresslikemommy.com med bestillingsnummeret ditt som emne.

 

2. Jeg bestilte noe, men vil endre farge eller størrelse på varen.

Du må kontakte oss innen 1 virkedag etter at bestillingen er lagt inn for å ordne en endring. Du kan gjøre dette ved å sende e-post til support@dresslikemommy.com med ditt nye farge- eller størrelsevalg.

 

3. Jeg bestilte noe, men vil endre leveringsadressen

Du må kontakte oss innen 1 virkedag etter at bestillingen er lagt inn for å ordne en endring. Du kan gjøre dette ved å sende e-post til support@dresslikemommy.com med din nye leveringsadresse.

Etter at du mottar en bestilling

1. Bestillingen min kom, men varene var to størrelser for store

Størrelsesbetegnelser kan variere. Hvis størrelsen eller målene ikke ser ut til å samsvare med bestillingen din, kontakt support@dresslikemommy.com med ordrenummeret og detaljene. Les våre gjeldende retningslinjer for refusjon før du sender en vare tilbake.

 

2. Bestillingen min kom, men jeg mottok feil varer

Vennligst kontakt oss på support@dresslikemommy.com og oppgi bestillingsnummeret ditt. Hvis feilen er vår, kan du sende varene tilbake, og vi sender deg riktige varer på vår regning (eller utsteder refusjon).

 

3. Bestillingen min kom, og jeg vil bytte størrelse/farge

Vennligst kontakt oss på support@dresslikemommy.com og oppgi bestillingsnummeret ditt. Du kan sende varen tilbake til oss, og vi vil sende deg en ny vare i oppdatert størrelse. *Portokostnader dekkes av deg.

 

4. Bestillingen min kom, men jeg vil returnere den.

Vennligst kontakt oss på support@dresslikemommy.com og oppgi bestillingsnummeret ditt. Du kan sende varen tilbake til oss, og vi vil utstede en refusjon. *Portokostnader dekkes av deg.

Our Story

Where Family Fashion Meets Real Connection

Dress Like Mommy was born from a simple idea: families that match together, bond together.

Dress Like Mommy grew from Francisco's family idea in Naples, Florida: the joy his daughters felt when they matched outfits with their mom. That spark — the giggles, the photos, and the "we're twinning!" moments — became the heart of a business dedicated to bringing families closer through fashion.

What We Do

We curate matching outfits for moms, dads, and kids — from cozy holiday pajamas to everyday casual sets and special occasion looks. Every piece is selected with comfort, style, and affordability in mind, so families everywhere can create those picture-perfect moments without breaking the bank.

Our Customers

We serve families across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, and Australia. Whether it's Christmas morning matching pajamas, a family photo shoot, or a fun day out twinning with your mini-me, our customers come to us for coordinated outfits that make getting dressed together simpler.

Quality & Care

Every item in our collection goes through a careful selection process. We partner with trusted manufacturers to offer the latest family matching styles at fair prices. If something isn't right with your order, our customer service team is here to make it right.

Why Shop With Us?

  • Family-Owned Business — Run by a real dad who gets it
  • Standard shipping included where a standard method is available
  • Family Matching Made Easy — Coordinated outfits for photos, holidays, trips, and everyday moments
  • Easy Returns — Clear return and exchange guidance in our refund policy
  • Secure Checkout — Your payment info is always protected

Connect With Us

We love seeing families match! Tag us on social media with #DressLikeMommy and share your moments.

  • Facebook
  • Instagram

Have questions? Visit our Contact Us page — we typically respond within one business day.

Dress Like Mommy — Making family moments even more special.

About us

A. General Questions

1. Is this site secure to use?

Yes. Checkout is hosted securely by Shopify and supports the payment methods shown at checkout. We do not store your full card details on our site.

 

2. How quickly do you respond to email queries?

We answer all email within one business days.

 

3. Where are you based?

Dress Like Mommy is an online store operated by FKG Trading LLC in Naples, Florida, USA. We work with manufacturing and fulfillment partners.

 

4. Why are you so cheap?

We select matching family outfits with affordability in mind. Prices and any available discounts are shown on the product page and at checkout.

Before You Place an Order

A. Sizing

1. Where can I find the sizing table in centimetres?

Use the size chart for the specific product and size you are considering. Check the units and whether the chart gives body measurements or garment measurements. Our sizing guide explains how to measure and compare sizes. If a chart or measurement is unclear, contact us before ordering.

 

2. Will I receive a two sizes larger item?

Size labels and measurements vary by product and manufacturer. Choose each item using its product-specific size chart and the available options, rather than assuming your usual letter size or applying a fixed size conversion. If you are unsure, contact us before ordering.

B. Payments

1. What type of payments do you accept?

We accept the payment methods displayed at checkout, including available card options.

 

2. I want to pay with my credit card, but I get redirected to PayPal page?

Select an available payment method at checkout. If you choose a third-party payment option, follow that provider’s instructions or select another available option before paying.

C. Shipping

1. What is the shipping price?

Standard shipping is included in product prices for countries and regions where a standard method is available. Checkout shows the exact shipping method, delivery estimate, and any express upgrade before payment.

 

2. Do you deliver to my country?

We ship to the countries and regions shown at checkout. If your country is not listed at checkout, contact us before placing an order.

 

3. How long will it take to get my order?

Processing and transit times vary by destination and carrier. Review the shipping policy for the current shipping details before checkout.

 

4. Do I need to pay any customs?

Customs duties, import taxes, or local fees may be charged by your destination country and are the customer's responsibility, unless checkout explicitly says they are included. We cannot mark orders as gifts or lower-value shipments.

After You Place an Order

A. Order Status

1. What does it mean: order status "Unfulfilled"?

Your order has not yet been marked as fulfilled. Orders are typically processed within 1-3 business days after payment confirmation. Tracking information is emailed when available after shipment.

 

2. What does it mean: order status "Fulfilled"?

That means your order is being shipped.

 

3. It's been too long, where is my order?

Please check your order's tracking for more information. If the problem remains please email us: info@dresslikemommy.com

B. Order Tracking

1. How do I track my order?

Tracking information is emailed when available after your order ships. You can also check the tracking information here: Track Your Order

 

2. My tracking code says “pending” or “no information available at the moment”.

Tracking may take 24-48 hours to update after the tracking number is issued. If information remains unavailable or your package is delayed, contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. My tracking code says “expired”

Please contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com and we will quickly solve this issue.

 

4. How do I stay updated about my order tracking?

Use the tracking link for the latest carrier updates. If your package is delayed, missing, or marked as delivered but not received, contact us with your order number and tracking information.

B. I want to change or cancel my order

1. I ordered something, but I want to cancel

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number as the subject.

 

2. I ordered something, but want to change the item color or size.

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new color or size option.

 

3. I ordered something, but want to change the delivery address

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new delivery address.

After You Receive an Order

A. I want to change or return my order

1. My order arrived, but the items were two sizes larger

Size labels can vary. If the size or measurements appear inconsistent with your order, contact info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and details. Review our current refund policy before sending an item back.

 

2. My order arrived, but I received the wrong items

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide us with your order number. If we’re at fault, you can send us back the items and we’ll send you out the correct items at our cost (or issue a refund).

 

3. My order arrived and I want to change the size/color

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Approved exchanges follow the current refund policy, including item-condition requirements and return-shipping responsibility.

 

4. My order arrived, but I want to return it.

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Review the refund policy for eligibility, return shipping, and refund timing before sending anything back.

Our Story

Where Family Fashion Meets Real Connection

Dress Like Mommy was born from a simple idea: families that match together, bond together.

Dress Like Mommy grew from Francisco's family idea in Naples, Florida: the joy his daughters felt when they matched outfits with their mom. That spark — the giggles, the photos, and the "we're twinning!" moments — became the heart of a business dedicated to bringing families closer through fashion.

What We Do

We curate matching outfits for moms, dads, and kids — from cozy holiday pajamas to everyday casual sets and special occasion looks. Every piece is selected with comfort, style, and affordability in mind, so families everywhere can create those picture-perfect moments without breaking the bank.

Our Customers

We serve families across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, and Australia. Whether it's Christmas morning matching pajamas, a family photo shoot, or a fun day out twinning with your mini-me, our customers come to us for coordinated outfits that make getting dressed together simpler.

Quality & Care

Every item in our collection goes through a careful selection process. We partner with trusted manufacturers to offer the latest family matching styles at fair prices. If something isn't right with your order, our customer service team is here to make it right.

Why Shop With Us?

  • Family-Owned Business — Run by a real dad who gets it
  • Standard shipping included where a standard method is available
  • Family Matching Made Easy — Coordinated outfits for photos, holidays, trips, and everyday moments
  • Easy Returns — Clear return and exchange guidance in our refund policy
  • Secure Checkout — Your payment info is always protected

Connect With Us

We love seeing families match! Tag us on social media with #DressLikeMommy and share your moments.

  • Facebook
  • Instagram

Have questions? Visit our Contact Us page — we typically respond within one business day.

Dress Like Mommy — Making family moments even more special.

Unde Moda Familială Întâlnește Conexiunea Adevărată

Dress Like Mommy a luat naștere dintr-o idee simplă: familiile care se asortează, se apropie.

Fondat în 2016 de Francisco, un tată a două fete din Naples, Florida, Dress Like Mommy a început când a observat cât de fericite erau fiicele lui de fiecare dată când se îmbrăcau la fel cu mama lor. Acea scânteie de bucurie — chicotelile, fotografiile, momentele „suntem gemene!” — a devenit inima unei afaceri dedicate să aducă familiile mai aproape prin modă.

Ce Facem

Selecționăm ținute asortate pentru mame, tați și copii — de la pijamale confortabile pentru sărbători, la seturi casual pentru fiecare zi și ținute pentru ocazii speciale. Fiecare piesă este aleasă cu grijă pentru confort, stil și preț accesibil, astfel încât familiile din toate colțurile să poată crea momente perfecte pentru fotografii fără să cheltuiască o avere.

Clienții Noștri

Din 2016, am deservit mii de familii din Statele Unite, Canada, Regatul Unit și Australia. Fie că este vorba de pijamale asortate în dimineața de Crăciun, o ședință foto de familie sau o zi distractivă în care te potrivești cu mini-me-ul tău, clienții noștri revin mereu pentru zâmbetele pe care aceste ținute le aduc.

Calitate și Grijă

Fiecare articol din colecția noastră trece printr-un proces atent de selecție. Colaborăm cu producători de încredere pentru a oferi cele mai noi stiluri de asortare familială la prețuri corecte. Dacă ceva nu este în regulă cu comanda ta, echipa noastră de servicii pentru clienți este aici să rezolve problema.

De Ce Să Cumpărați De La Noi?

  • Afacere de Familie — Condusă de un tată adevărat care înțelege
  • Transport Gratuit la toate comenzile
  • Mii de Familii Fericite din 2016
  • Returnări Ușoare — Politică de returnare fără bătăi de cap în 30 de zile
  • Plată Securizată — Informațiile tale de plată sunt mereu protejate

Conectează-te Cu Noi

Ne place să vedem familii care se asortează! Etichetează-ne pe rețelele sociale cu #DressLikeMommy și împărtășește momentele tale.

  • Facebook
  • Instagram

Ai întrebări? Vizitează pagina noastră Contactează-ne — de obicei răspundem în decurs de o zi lucrătoare.
